correctness.rationale: The two-stage Gauss endpoint filter equals \(1-12x/(x^2+6x+12)\). Exact entries on \(n=3,4,5\) have positive rational numerators for every \(h>0\). For \(n\ge6\), the cycle Green kernel gives adjacent sign \(-(n-1)(n-5)/(nh)+O_n(h^{-2})\). The universal witness at \(h=8\) follows from the exact rational \(n=6\) entry and a certified complex-resolvent periodization bound for every \(n\ge7\). A standalone exact verifier checks rational identities by degree-bounded interpolation, the six-cycle witness and every rational enclosure used in the infinite bound. Finite experiments are not treated as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural classification of positivity for an A-stable fourth-order implicit heat integrator on uniform periodic spatial meshes. Its sharp \(n=5\) to \(n=6\) boundary and one universal failure timestep for all larger cycles identify a resolution-dependent sign defect not predicted by scalar absolute monotonicity or spectral stability.
